verses.geez: ቃለ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘኮነ፡ ኀበ፡ ኢዩኤል፡ ወልደ፡ ባቱኤል።
verses.translation: The word of the Lord which came to Joel the son of Bathuel.

translations.lxx: The word of the Lord which came to Joel the son of Bathuel.
translations.kjv: The word of the LORD that came to Joel the son of Pethuel.
translations.ron: Cuvântul Domnului care a fost către Ioil, fiul lui Petuel.

verses.geez: ስምዑ፡ ዘንተ፡ ሊቃውንት፡ ወአጽምዑ፡ ኮልክሙ፡ እለ፡ ትነብሩ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ለእመ፡ ከዊነ፡ ኮነ፡ ከመዝ፡ በመዋዕሊክሙ፡ ወበመዋዕለ፡ አበዊክሙ።
verses.translation: Hear these words, ye elders, and hearken all ye that inhabit the land. Have such things happened in your days, or in the days of your fathers?

translations.lxx: Hear these words, ye elders, and hearken all ye that inhabit the land. Have such things happened in your days, or in the days of your fathers?
translations.kjv: Hear this, ye old men, and give ear, all ye inhabitants of the land. Hath this been in your days, or even in the days of your fathers?
translations.ron: Ascultaţi acestea, voi bătrânilor, luaţi aminte, voi toţi locuitorii ţării! Oare s-a mai întâmplat aşa în vremea voastră sau în zilele părinţilor voştri?

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ትንግሩ፡ ለደቂቅክ፡ ወደቂቅክሙ፡ ለደቂቆሙ፡ ወደቂቆሙኒ፡ ለለካእ፡ ትውልድ።
verses.translation: Tell your children concerning them, and let your children tell their children, and their children another generation.

translations.lxx: Tell your children concerning them, and let your children tell their children, and their children another generation.
translations.kjv: Tell ye your children of it, and let your children tell their children, and their children another generation.
translations.ron: Povestiţi-le feciorilor voştri, iar ei feciorilor lor, iar aceia neamului care va veni după ei!

verses.geez: ዘአትረፈ፡ ዕፄ፡ በልዐ፡ አንበጣ፡ ወዘአትረፈ፡ አንበጣ፡ ለበልዐ፡ ደጎብያ። ወዘአትረፈ፡ ደጎብያ፡ በልዐ፡ አናኩዕ።
verses.translation: The leavings of the caterpillar has the locust eaten, and the leavings of the locust has the palmerworm eaten, and the leavings of the palmerworm has the cankerworm eaten.

translations.lxx: The leavings of the caterpillar has the locust eaten, and the leavings of the locust has the palmerworm eaten, and the leavings of the palmerworm has the cankerworm eaten.
translations.kjv: That which the palmerworm hath left hath the locust eaten; and that which the locust hath left hath the cankerworm eaten; and that which the cankerworm hath left hath the caterpiller eaten.
translations.ron: Ceea ce a rămas de la lăcustele mici au mâncat lăcustele mari, şi ceea ce a rămas de la cele mari au mâncat cele zburătoare, şi ceea ce a rămas de la cele zburătoare au prăpădit stolurile de lăcuste.

verses.geez: ንዝሁ፡ እለ፡ ትሰትዩ፡ ወይነ፡ ብክዩ፡ ወላሕዉ፡ ኩልክሙ፡ እለ፡ ትሰትይዎ፡ ለወይን፡ ለስካር፡ እስመ፡ ትስዕረ፡ ኃሤት፡ ዋፍስሐ፡ እምአፋክሙ።
verses.translation: Awake, ye drunkards, from your wine, and weep: mourn, all ye that drink wine to drunkenness: for joy and gladness are removed from your mouth.

translations.lxx: Awake, ye drunkards, from your wine, and weep: mourn, all ye that drink wine to drunkenness: for joy and gladness are removed from your mouth.
translations.kjv: Awake, ye drunkards, and weep; and howl, all ye drinkers of wine, because of the new wine; for it is cut off from your mouth.
translations.ron: Deşteptaţi-vă, beţivilor, şi plângeţi! Şi voi, băutorilor de vin, tânguiţi-vă pentru vinul cel nou, căci vi s-a luat de la gură.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ዐርጉ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ክመሙ፡ ጽንዓን፡ ወአልቦሙ፡ ኁለወቄ፡ ስነኒሆሙ፡ ስናን፡ አናብስት፡ ወኲርናዓቲሆሙ፡ ዘእጓለ፡ አንበሳ።
verses.translation: For a strong and innumerable nation is come up against my land, their teeth are lion's teeth, and their back teeth those of a lion's whelp.

translations.lxx: For a strong and innumerable nation is come up against my land, their teeth are lion's teeth, and their back teeth those of a lion's whelp.
translations.kjv: For a nation is come up upon my land, strong, and without number, whose teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he hath the cheek teeth of a great lion.
translations.ron: Căci un popor a năvălit în ţara mea, puternic şi fără de număr; dinţii lui ca dinţii de leu, iar fălcile, ca fălcile de leoaică.

verses.geez: ረሰይዎ፡ ምድረ፡ ለወይንየ፡ ወሰበሩ፡ በለስየ፡ ወኀሠሡ፡ ወፈተኑ፡ ወገደፋ፡ በዘ፡ አፃዕደወት፡ አዕጹቂሃ።
verses.translation: He has ruined my vine, and utterly broken my fig-trees: he has utterly searched my vine, and cast it down; he has peeled its branches.

translations.lxx: He has ruined my vine, and utterly broken my fig-trees: he has utterly searched my vine, and cast it down; he has peeled its branches.
translations.kjv: He hath laid my vine waste, and barked my fig tree: he hath made it clean bare, and cast it away; the branches thereof are made white.
translations.ron: Pustiit-a via mea, iar smochinul meu mi l-a făcut bucăţi; l-a jupuit de coajă şi l-a trântit la pământ. Mlădiţele de vită au rămas albe.

verses.geez: ብኪ፡ ሊተ፡ በእንተ፡ መርዓት፡ እንተ፡ ቀነተት፡ ሠቀ፡ በእንተ፡ ምታ፡ ዘእምድናግልናሃ።
verses.translation: Lament to me more than a virgin girded with sackcloth for the husband of her youth.

translations.lxx: Lament to me more than a virgin girded with sackcloth for the husband of her youth.
translations.kjv: Lament like a virgin girded with sackcloth for the husband of her youth.
translations.ron: Tânguieşte-te ca o fecioară încinsă cu sac după bărbatul din tinereţea ei!

verses.geez: ተሥዕት፡ ወሞጻሕት፡ እምቤተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ላሕው፡ ካህናት፡ እለ፡ ትገብሩ፡ መስዋዕተ።
verses.translation: The meat-offering and drink-offering are removed from the house of the Lord: mourn, ye priests that serve at the altar of the Lord.

translations.lxx: The meat-offering and drink-offering are removed from the house of the Lord: mourn, ye priests that serve at the altar of the Lord.
translations.kjv: The meat offering and the drink offering is cut off from the house of the LORD; the priests, the LORD’s ministers, mourn.
translations.ron: Prinosul şi jertfa cu turnare nu mai sunt în templul Domnului! Preoţii, slujitorii Domnului, sunt în mare jale.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ኀስራ፡ ገራውህ፡ ወትላሑ፡ ምድር፡ እስመ፡ ኀስረ፡ እክል፡ ወየብሰ፡ ዋይን፡ ወጥፍአ፡ ዘይት።
verses.translation: For the plains languish: let the land mourn, for the corn languishes; the wine is dried up, the oil becomes scarce;

translations.lxx: For the plains languish: let the land mourn, for the corn languishes; the wine is dried up, the oil becomes scarce;
translations.kjv: The field is wasted, the land mourneth; for the corn is wasted: the new wine is dried up, the oil languisheth.
translations.ron: Câmpul a rămas pustiu, ţarina este plină de jale; grâul nu mai este, mustul ajuns-a de ocară, iar untdelemn n-a rămas chiar nici un strop!

verses.geez: ተኅፍሩ፡ ሓረስት፡ ወበከዩ፡ ዓቀብተ፡ ወይን፡ በእንተ፡ ስርናይ፡ ወሰገም፡ እስመ፡ ጠፍአ፡ ማእረር፡ እምገራውህ።
verses.translation: the husbandmen are consumed: mourn your property on account of the wheat and barley; for the harvest has perished from off the field.

translations.lxx: the husbandmen are consumed: mourn your property on account of the wheat and barley; for the harvest has perished from off the field.
translations.kjv: Be ye ashamed, O ye husbandmen; howl, O ye vinedressers, for the wheat and for the barley; because the harvest of the field is perished.
translations.ron: Plugarii sunt zăpăciţi, stăpânii de vii se tânguiesc pentru grâu şi pentru orz, căci secerişul din ţarini este pierdut.

verses.geez: ወየብሰ፡ ወይን፡ ወኅልቀ፡ በለስ፡ ሮማን፡ ወትምርት፡ ወኮል፡ ወኰሉ፡ አቅማሐ፡ ገዳም፡ የብሰ፡ ወተኀፍረ፡ ፍስሀሆሙ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ እጓለ፡ እመሕያው።
verses.translation: The vine is dried up, and the fig-trees are become few; the pomegranate, and palm-tree, and apple, and all the trees of the field are dried up: for the sons of men have abolished joy.

translations.lxx: The vine is dried up, and the fig-trees are become few; the pomegranate, and palm-tree, and apple, and all the trees of the field are dried up: for the sons of men have abolished joy.
translations.kjv: The vine is dried up, and the fig tree languisheth; the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, even all the trees of the field, are withered: because joy is withered away from the sons of men.
translations.ron: Viţa de vie este fără vlagă, smochinul tânjeşte, rodiile de asemenea şi finicii, merii şi toţi copacii de pe câmp s-au uscat; ba mai mult, bucuria ajuns-a ocară pentru fiii oamenilor.

verses.geez: ላሕዉ፡ ወቅንቱ፡ ሠቀ፡ ካህናት፡ ወብክ፡ እለ፡ ትሠውዑ፡ መስዋዕተ፡ ሖሩ፡ ስክቡ፡ ውስተ፡ ሠቅ፡ እለ፡ ትሰውዑ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ እስመ፡ ኀልቀ፡ መስዋዕት፡ ወሞጾህት፡ እምቤተ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: Gird yourselves with sackcloth, and lament, ye priests: mourn, ye that serve at the altar: go in, sleep in sackcloths, ye that minister to God: for the meat-offering and drink-offering are withheld from the house of your God.

translations.lxx: Gird yourselves with sackcloth, and lament, ye priests: mourn, ye that serve at the altar: go in, sleep in sackcloths, ye that minister to God: for the meat-offering and drink-offering are withheld from the house of your God.
translations.kjv: Gird yourselves, and lament, ye priests: howl, ye ministers of the altar: come, lie all night in sackcloth, ye ministers of my God: for the meat offering and the drink offering is withholden from the house of your God.
translations.ron: Încingeţi-vă şi vă tânguiţi, voi preoţilor, izbucniţi în bocete, voi slujitori ai altarului! Intraţi în templu şi petreceţi noaptea în sac de jale, voi slujitori ai lui Dumnezeu, căci prinosul şi jertfa cu turnare au fost îndepărtate din templul Dumnezeului vostru!

verses.geez: ቀድሱ፡ ጾመ፡ ወስብኩ፡ ምህላላ፡ ስተጋብኡ፡ ሊቃውነተ፡ ወኲሎ፡ ዘይነብር፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ውስተ፡ ቤተ፡ አምላክነ፡ ወጽርሑ፡ ኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ኀቡረ።
verses.translation: Sanctify a fast, proclaim a solemn service, gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land into the house of your God, and cry earnestly to the Lord,

translations.lxx: Sanctify a fast, proclaim a solemn service, gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land into the house of your God, and cry earnestly to the Lord,
translations.kjv: Sanctify ye a fast, call a solemn assembly, gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land into the house of the LORD your God, and cry unto the LORD.
translations.ron: Postiţi post sfânt, strângeţi obşte de prăznuire, adunaţi pe bătrâni, pe toţi locuitorii ţării în templul Dumnezeului vostru şi strigaţi către Domnul rugându-L:

verses.geez: አሌሊተ፡ አሌሊተ፡ ይእተ፡ ዕለተ፡ እስመ፡ አልጸቀት፡ ዕለት፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዋካማዝ፡ እምነ፡ መቅሠፍት፡ ውስተ፡ መቅሠፍት፡ ይመጽእ።
verses.translation: Alas, alas, alas for the day! for the day of the Lord is nigh, and it will come as trouble upon trouble.

translations.lxx: Alas, alas, alas for the day! for the day of the Lord is nigh, and it will come as trouble upon trouble.
translations.kjv: Alas for the day! for the day of the LORD is at hand, and as a destruction from the Almighty shall it come.
translations.ron: "O, ce zi! Căci aproape este ziua Domnului şi vine ca o pustiire de la Cel Atotputernic.

verses.geez: በቅድመ፡ አዕይንቲክሙ፡ ይጠፍእ፡ እክል፡ እምቤተ፡ አምላክክሙ፡ ፍስሐ፡ ወኃሴት።
verses.translation: Your meat has been destroyed before your eyes, joy and gladness from out of the house of your God.

translations.lxx: Your meat has been destroyed before your eyes, joy and gladness from out of the house of your God.
translations.kjv: Is not the meat cut off before our eyes, yea, joy and gladness from the house of our God?
translations.ron: Oare nu ni s-a luat hrana de sub ochii noştri, bucuria şi veselia din templul Dumnezeului nostru?

verses.geez: እጎልት፡ በውስተ፡ ኀዝአቶን፡ ጠፍአ፡ ወኀልቁ፡ መዛግብት፡ ወተነስቱ፡ ምክያዳት፡ እስመ፡ ብሰ፡ እክል።
verses.translation: The heifers have started at their mangers, the treasures are abolished, the wine-presses are broken down; for the corn is withered.

translations.lxx: The heifers have started at their mangers, the treasures are abolished, the wine-presses are broken down; for the corn is withered.
translations.kjv: The seed is rotten under their clods, the garners are laid desolate, the barns are broken down; for the corn is withered.
translations.ron: Seminţele s-au uscat sub bulgării din brazdă, grânarele sunt goale, hambarele sunt fără nimic în ele, căci nu mai este grâu.

verses.geez: ምንተ፡ እንከ፡ ንሠይም፡ ነ፡ በከዩ፡ አዕዳደ፡ ላሕም፡ እስመ፡ ኀልቀ፡ መርዔቶሙ፡ ወጠፍአ፡ መራዕየ፡ አባግዕ።
verses.translation: What shall we store up for ourselves? the herds of cattle have mourned, because they had no pasture; and the flocks of sheep have been utterly destroyed.

translations.lxx: What shall we store up for ourselves? the herds of cattle have mourned, because they had no pasture; and the flocks of sheep have been utterly destroyed.
translations.kjv: How do the beasts groan! the herds of cattle are perplexed, because they have no pasture; yea, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.
translations.ron: Cum gem vitele! Cirezile de boi mugesc, căci nu află nicăieri păşune; chiar şi turmele de oi sunt în mare lipsă.

verses.geez: ኀቤከ፡ እግዚኦ፡ እጸርሕ፡ እስመ፡ እሳት፡ አኀለቀ፡ ስነ፡ ገዳም፡ ወነበልባል፡ አውዐየ፡ ዕፀ፡ ዖእዋም።
verses.translation: To thee, O Lord, will I cry: for fire has devoured the fair places of the wilderness, and a flame has burnt up all the trees of the field.

translations.lxx: To thee, O Lord, will I cry: for fire has devoured the fair places of the wilderness, and a flame has burnt up all the trees of the field.
translations.kjv: O LORD, to thee will I cry: for the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame hath burned all the trees of the field.
translations.ron: Către Tine, Doamne, strig! Căci focul a mistuit toate păşunile pustiului şi văpaia lui a dogorit toţi copacii de pe câmp.

verses.geez: ወአንቃዕደዉ፡ ኀቤከ፡ እንስሳ፡ ሐቅል፡ እስመ፡ የብስ፡ አንቅዕተ፡ ማያት፡ ወበልዐት፡ እሳት፡ ስነ፡ ገዳም።
verses.translation: And the cattle of the field have looked up to thee: for the fountains of waters have been dried up, and fire has devoured the fair places of the wilderness.

translations.lxx: And the cattle of the field have looked up to thee: for the fountains of waters have been dried up, and fire has devoured the fair places of the wilderness.
translations.kjv: The beasts of the field cry also unto thee: for the rivers of waters are dried up, and the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness.
translations.ron: Şi fiarele câmpului zbiară către tine, căci pâraiele de apă au secat şi focul a mistuit păşunile stepei".
